title: 重整交易脈動首頁、Persona 明細和績效排行

acceptance_1_layout_and_verifiable_metri.summary: TradingPulsePage renders in strict top-to-bottom sequence: (1) Operational Personas summary (paper/canary/live breakdown and single paper-baseline summary), (2) Comparable P&L subtotals and Persona coverage (summary.pnlGroups with currency, period, as-of timestamp, and source-verified P&L definition), (3) Notable trading events, (4) Persona trading details table, (5) Concise performance rankings, and (6) Collapsed-by-default Data Diagnostics. Numbers use thousands separators, currency-appropriate 2-decimal precision, percentages, basis points, and localized timestamps via safeDateTime.

acceptance_2_chengchuan_2317_and_degrade.summary: Dynamically renders the 澄川 (2317) case as Paper (模擬交易), 0 fills (0 筆成交 / 尚未成交), 0% fill rate (該次意向 452 股、成交 0 股 / 0/452 SHARES), no fill P&L yet (尚無成交損益（帳本幣別 TWD） with zero digits in the P&L cell), insufficient cash pre-broker risk rejection (資金不足 / 送券商前風控拒單（未送出委託）), and a verified Trade Journey link. Distinguishes 0/0 no orders submitted, 0/452 source failure, stale telemetry, normal empty roster, all-probe exclusion via BFF operator_scope, partial scope, full source failure, rankings endpoint failure, and legacy unverified operator_scope without any frontend probe classifier or hardcoded exclusion list.

acceptance_3_diagnostics_rankings_i18n_a.summary: Removes the 7 raw surface status cards, LIVE BFF badge, Row health, Checks, technical IDs (rt-*, rb-*, persona-*), repeated per-row baseline badges, empty leaderboards, unused legacy pulse translation keys, and runtime-module test fixtures. Converges wire alias normalization in management.ts, relocates the two recorded wire fixtures to src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/fixtures/trading-pulse.ts, and uses the single shared tradeJourneyHref helper for exact journey and persona-filtered journey navigation with tenant/environment/return_to preservation. Expandable Data Diagnostics preserves surface sources, effective timestamps, and runtime/binding locators. Rankings are locale-consistent in zh-TW and en-US with verified names, symbols, units, comparison scopes, and real reasons for unranked Personas; negative P&L is explicitly labeled as loss and never described as profit.

runtime_budget.notes: Frontend UI component, shared journey link helper, test fixture relocation, and i18n locale dictionary update only; no background jobs, timers, or persistent writers added.

residual_findings.scope_boundary: src/platform/components/EntityHeader.tsx and scripts/accept-trading-pulse-hosted-readonly.mjs are outside FE-TRADING-PULSE-OPERATOR-PAGE-20261122 scoped artifacts.
residual_findings.description: TradingPulsePage appends return_to=/management/trading-pulse and return_label to Trade Journey links via tradeJourneyHref so TradeJourneyDetailPage and TradeJourneysPage render a visible <a href="/management/trading-pulse"> on both 1440px desktop and 390px mobile. On /management/personas/:id, however, SideNav is hidden below lg (390px) and EntityHeader.tsx renders a <button> (navigate(-1)) rather than an <a href="/management/trading-pulse">. If returnViaScreen in scripts/accept-trading-pulse-hosted-readonly.mjs queries only visible <a> elements on /management/personas/:id at 390px without falling back to the EntityHeader back button or Ctrl+K command palette, narrow-viewport return from PersonaDetail will require either EntityHeader return_to link support or a returnViaScreen fallback in Task E (TRADING-PULSE-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261122).
